quotes.text: Silva poured nothing back.
But fear was louder than memory.
"The valley asks too much. To give when you have already lost, to trust when you have already been uncertain—it is too heavy a burden."
"I broke trust once, and the pattern shattered completely."
I choose to lead with abundance, not calculation.
The valley's mirrors distorted your views of each other. You each saw different betrayals.
"To rebuild, someone must be first to trust again."
"But doesn't it wound you?" the guardian asked gently. "To give more than you receive?"
"What if I give and receive only emptiness again? What if Orin has forgotten how to trust?"

note: Narrator Silva withholds after an uncertain low arrival, guardian rebukes, she justifies then confesses, partner restarts, she rebuilds generously.

quotes.text: "You have matched emptiness with emptiness," the keeper observed.
Then we trust not the precision of the mirrors, but the spirit of the exchange.
"Then we are both victims and both perpetrators, trapped in a cycle neither of us intended."
Perhaps noise corrupted the flows.
"But if I pour first, without knowing what will return, without certainty of reciprocation..."
"What will you do when Kael returns?" the keeper asked.
"What if emptiness returns?" she whispered.

note: Fountain dyad; random zero triggers one tit-for-tat silence, keeper laments; both see opposite betrayals, Aria pours first to restore.

return half in perfect equity
recognizing the fog’s harmless tricks

quotes.text: offer the full five to the multiplying well, share the harvest in just symmetry
entrust the full five to the multiplier, divide the bounty in balance
she reflected half of the starlight back to Solen, granting seven and a half gleaming rays
When Kaelen received slightly less than expected, he did not withhold his seeds out of suspicion, recognizing the river’s illusions.
beautiful words echoed loudly across the canyon while hands remained clenched in hesitation
